item.title: Suzhou Tongli Lake Resort — Villa 2 Nights from ¥599 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: villa twin room, 2 nights — ¥599 (≈$84) (was ¥699) · Phase-2 comfort / superior / garden room (pick one), 2 nights — ¥799 (≈$112, was ¥1,099) · Phase-2 lake room, 2 nights — ¥999 (≈$140, was ¥1,599) · Each tier: 1 room × 2 nights or 2 rooms × 1 night · ⏰ valid through Mar 31, 2027 · Weekends and New Year at no surcharge

Tongli Lake Resort sits on the shore of Tongli Lake in Suzhou’s Wujiang district, surrounded on three sides by water across about 60,000㎡ of Jiangnan gardens — white walls, grey tiles and tree-lined paths, with the lake on the doorstep. The resort’s 253 rooms run 40–47㎡ with bright floor-to-ceiling windows, and the deal adds daily breakfast for two (children under 1.2 m free), two servings of late-night congee per room-night, unlimited indoor and outdoor kids’ playgrounds, the petting zoo, and indoor heated pools for adults and children, plus the gym and table tennis.

item.title: Xiamen Marriott Haicang — Breakfast Buffet for Two from ¥99 (≈$14)
item.description:
Deal price: breakfast buffet for two — ¥99 (≈$14) (was ¥276) · Single breakfast × 10, splittable — ¥458 (≈$64, was ¥2,760) · Daily: weekdays 6:30–10:00, weekends and holidays 6:30–10:30 · ⏰ valid through Mar 31, 2027

Xiamen Marriott Haicang (厦门泰地万豪酒店) sits on Haicang Avenue in the Haicang CBD, across the water from Xiamen Island. Its ground-floor Gongchu restaurant serves a full breakfast buffet every morning: hot dishes cooked several ways, freshly steamed dim sum and mixed-grain items, crispy youtiao (great dunked in soy milk or noodle soup), a bread corner with European-style loaves, toast and scones, plus congee, soy milk, milk and noodle soup — Chinese and Western tastes both covered, in a bright, spacious dining room with an open kitchen.

Xiamen Marriott Haicang (厦门泰地万豪酒店) sits on Haicang Avenue in the Haicang CBD, across the water from Xiamen Island. Its ground-floor Gongchu buffet restaurant runs an open kitchen serving a rotating seasonal spread: a seafood section with live-caught steamed seafood and crayfish, a sashimi and Japanese counter, a hot-dish range including fragrant clay-pot (啫啫煲) dishes, and a dessert station — with the menu changing by season, so the day’s actual dishes are what the restaurant serves that evening.

item.title: Hefei Aviation Science Day Camp — Little Captain Training on Nov 7 from ¥159 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: one-day camp per person (lunch included, Saturday Nov 7 session) — ¥199 (≈$28) (was ¥799) · ¥159 (≈$22) after the ¥40-off-¥199 coupon · Single-day event: November 7, 2026 only · ⏰ valid for Nov 7, 2026 only

On Saturday, November 7, the Hefei Aviation Science Museum at Luogang Park turns kids into little captains for a full day, 9:00–17:00. The day opens with a pilot-uniform dress-up, then an aviation science class through the “Millennium Dream of Flight” and “A Century of Aviation” halls, plus the museum’s naked-eye 3D four-sided CAVE cinema. Hands-on blocks follow: a VR dream flying-saucer, BATD basic flight trainer (Cessna 172), a 1:1 Airbus A320 cockpit simulator with instructor scoring, robot-dog interaction, and a Su-27 model-aircraft build. After lunch and a break, the afternoon is all about kites — kite class, kite painting and kite flying — before a certificate ceremony crowns each child a “Little Aviator.”

item.title: Ningbo Xiangshan Banbianshan Guantang Resort — Seaside Stay + Seafood Dinner from ¥399 (≈$56)
item.description:
Deal price: 30–40㎡ Guantang room, 1 night + 2 breakfasts + hanfu experience + seafood dinner for two — ¥399 (≈$56) (was ¥699) · 2-night version + seafood noodles + hot spring tickets — ¥699 (≈$98, was ¥1,199) · Bookable Oct 29 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Banbianshan Guantang sits inside the Banbianshan seaside resort area in Xiangshan, Ningbo — a hotel designed around its coastal setting, with reef, fishing-boat and wave motifs woven through the lobby and rooms, and 126 rooms in total. The beach is a short walk from the room blocks, so sea views, sand play and paddling are right outside the door, and the hotel’s Jiangnan-courtyard corners, covered bridges and pavilions make for easy photo stops.

item.title: Shenzhen Hurricane Adventure — Full-Sensory Immersive Park from ¥29.9 (≈$4)
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥29.9 (≈$4) (was ¥88) · Parent-child ticket (1 adult + 1 child under 1.5 m) — ¥39.9 (≈$6, was ¥128) · Family ticket (2 adults + 1 child, or 1 adult + 2 children under 1.5 m) — ¥49.9 (≈$7, was ¥168) · Bookable Oct 27 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

In Shenzhen’s Nanshan district, Hurricane Adventure is a full-sensory immersive park built around two original shows that loop all day: The North Sea Kraken and Ne Zha Stirs the Sea. A giant immersive screen, multi-sensory effects and motion-adventure staging put you inside the story rather than in front of it — and one ticket covers both shows with unlimited same-day re-entry, so you can step out for a meal and come back for another round.

item.title: Zhangzhou Longjia Hot Spring Hotel — Private In-Room Hot Spring Stay from ¥558 (≈$78)
item.description:
Deal price: luxury hot spring room (45㎡, private soaking pool), 1 night + 2 breakfasts + 2 hot spring vouchers — ¥558 (≈$78) (was ¥798) · Themed family room (with private pool), 1 room × 2 nights or 2 rooms × 1 night — ¥1,198 (≈$168, was ¥1,936) · Bookable Oct 30 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Longjia Hotel anchors the 200,000㎡ Longjia Eco Hot Spring Resort in Zhangzhou’s Taiwan-investment zone — a lakeside property in classic Minnan swallow-tail-roof style, shaped like a spreading eagle, with open grassland in front and a forested lake island behind. Every hot spring room comes with its own private soaking pool, open 24 hours, and the resort’s hot spring park — a local favorite for over 20 years — holds 30+ pools across hydrotherapy, herbal-medicine and flower-petal zones.

item.title: Anxi Xihe Mountain Tea Resort — 4A Tea-Culture Park Stay + Breakfasts for 2 Adults & 2 Kids, from ¥299 (≈$42)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a balcony room + breakfasts for 2 adults & 2 kids + park admission — from ¥299 (≈$42) (was ¥999, about 30% of list) · Bookable Oct 29 – Dec 31, 2026 · Weekends at no surcharge · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Xihe Mountain （溪禾山） sits in Anxi County, the home of Tieguanyin oolong, and the resort lies inside a 4A-rated tea-culture park — the same tea-country scenery used as a music-video backdrop. Late October is cockscomb-flower season in the park, and the stay bundles the room with the whole estate: breakfasts for 2 adults and 2 kids (kids under 1.2 m), park admission for the same 2 adults and 2 kids, free indoor playground for the children and free parking. Between outings, the resort’s tea rooms keep the pace slow — guests praise the on-site afternoon tea, where a pot runs as little as ¥30 for three infusions — and on rainy days the covered terrace keeps the conversation going.

item.title: Hefei Yuanxiao'ao Magic Bookstore — 1,500㎡ Immersive Kids' Wonderland from ¥79 (≈$11)
item.description:
Deal price: parent-child ticket (1 adult + 1 child under 1.5 m) — ¥79 (≈$11) (was ¥199) · 2-person ticket — ¥89 (≈$13, was ¥258) · Family ticket — ¥118 (≈$17, was ¥299) · Bookable Oct 26 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Tucked into Hefei’s Hechai 1972 cultural park, Yuanxiao’ao is a 1,500㎡ “magic bookstore” where bookshelves give way to immersive worlds. One ticket covers the lot: Deep-Sea Fantasy, Dinosaur Archives and Space Voyage zones, Fly over China and Fly over Anhui in the motion flying cinema, a 9 m six-screen sci-fi CAVE space with 100-megapixel 720° immersion, and the Magic Creative Space — magic painting, building blocks and star sand for younger makers. The wristband allows unlimited same-day re-entry, so you can dip in and out between the park’s cafés and shops.

item.title: Qiyun Mountain Resort Hotel — Double 11 Deal: 1 Night + Scenic Combo from ¥369 (≈$52)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast + 2-person scenic combo — from ¥369 (≈$52) (was ¥1,199) · 2 nights from ¥699 (≈$98, or ¥669 after the ¥30-off-¥600 coupon) · Bookable Oct 28 – Dec 31, 2026 · No weekend surcharge · In November, guests under 18 enter the scenic area free · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Qiyun Mountain （齐云山） in Xiuning County, Huangshan, is one of China’s four great Taoist mountains, and the Qiyun Mountain Resort Hotel sits inside the scenic area in Yanqian Village — you sleep in the attraction rather than commuting to it. Autumn is peak sea-of-clouds season, and every package bundles the room with the mountain: scenic-area admission, a bamboo raft ride on the Heng River, Xiaoyao Street entry and the Freehome family campsite — petting zoo, rope nets, sand treasure hunts, forest maze, mini golf and archery. Higher tiers add the Feiyue Qiyun flying experience, heritage craft sessions (papermaking, paper-cutting, iron painting, lacquer fans), night shows and shuttle transfers, and every tier includes a free room upgrade on a reservation note. Each room can bring one child under 1.2 m free.

item.title: Xiamen Shengzhixiang Hot Spring Day Tickets — Single ¥99.9 (≈$14) or Family Ticket ¥198 (≈$28)
item.description:
Deal price: single hot-spring ticket — ¥99.9 (≈$14) (was ¥198) · Family ticket (2 adults + 1 child under 1.5 m + 1 child under 1.2 m) — ¥198 (≈$28) (was ¥396) · Bookable Oct 27 – Dec 31, 2026 · Weekdays and weekends, no surcharge · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Shengzhixiang sits on natural sodium-bicarbonate springs deep under Tingxi valley in Tong’an — water nicknamed “beauty soup” — and its signature is the grotto hot spring: warm in winter, cool in summer, constant temperature all year. The outdoor spring park runs original-soup pools with free tea service, pools of every size tucked among flowers by an infinity pool, and water that flows and refreshes continuously. This is the day-ticket version of the resort’s offer (no overnight stay): come for the soak, stay for the hillside boardwalk, and let the kids loose in the water park and indoor playground between pools.

item.title: Yangzhou Slender West Lake Songcheng Resort Hotel — 2 Nights or 2 Rooms from ¥499 (≈$70)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 room × 2 consecutive nights OR 2 rooms × 1 night — from ¥499 (≈$70) (was ¥1,198) · Single-night full bundle also ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥799) · Bookable Oct 26, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Weekends at no surcharge through January 2027 · ⏰ valid through Mar 31, 2027

The Songcheng Resort Hotel sits a short shuttle ride from Yangzhou’s Slender West Lake （瘦西湖）, the city’s signature willow-lined lake of pavilions and arched bridges. Rooms are 25–28㎡ view rooms (king or twin, no extra bed), and every package adds welcome fruit, a couple photoshoot and a scenic-area shuttle. The single-night bundle goes further: Qunyuan morning-tea set for two — Yangzhou’s beloved breakfast-tea ritual — plus two Slender West Lake daytime tickets and two hot-spring tickets, so one night covers the lake by day and the springs after.

item.title: Chikan Ancient Town Resort, Kaiping — 1 Night + 2 Days Unlimited Park Entry for 2 Adults & 2 Kids, from ¥728 (≈$103)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 days unlimited park entry for 2 adults & 2 kids — from ¥728 (≈$103) (was ¥1,588, about 46% of list) · Bookable through Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026

Chikan is one of Guangdong’s most lovingly kept old towns: arcaded qilou streets built by returned overseas Chinese, a hundred shows a month, and a new theme every season — right now it’s the Chikan Monster Night (Oct 15 – Nov 6), with parades down streets paved orange with marigolds. This Double-11 bundle puts you inside it: 1 night in an official town hotel, 2 days of unlimited re-entry to the whole ancient town for 2 adults and 2 kids (kids under 1.2 m), breakfasts, a free in-town shuttle, and two “Grandmaster” theatre seats (limited, first-come-first-served).

item.title: Huangshan Xiangyuan Yungu Resort — Stay Inside Huangshan Scenic Area + Hot Springs, from ¥730 (≈$103)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfasts + hot springs + shuttle — from ¥730 (≈$103) (was ¥3,588, about 20% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026 · No weekend surcharge

A ¥150-million Huizhou-style resort built from a cluster of five historic Anhui dwellings, right inside the Huangshan scenic area on the must-pass road to the Yungu cableway — so you wake up on the mountain instead of commuting to it. Autumn here runs mid-October to late November, when the forests turn gold and the air smells of osmanthus; sit in the courtyard with tea, then soak in the mountain hot springs as the mist rolls in. The hotel won the “Five Continents Diamond Award — Brand Resort Hotel of the Year” at the 2020 World Hotel Forum.

item.title: Qingdao Sunac Land — 10 Rides Unlimited for 2 Days, from ¥99 (≈$14)
item.description:
Deal price: 10 rides, unlimited, for 2 consecutive days — from ¥99 (≈$14) (was ¥138, about 72% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Qingdao’s one-stop indoor family park inside the Oriental Movie Metropolis (Sunac Mall), split into two themed zones — Laoshan Wonders and a German-style town. The headline rides: Laoshan Flying Dragon, a custom indoor suspended coaster that dives from a mountaintop into the sea; a 16.6 m pendulum swinging a full 240°; a rocket-style drop tower; a spinning music ship; plus gentler classics — carousel, flower-basket Ferris wheel, samba balloons, bumper cars and an 80 m indoor driving school for little drivers. One ticket covers all 10 rides, unlimited, across 2 consecutive days — go back the next day and ride your favorites again.

item.title: Qiyun Mountain Ziyoujia Treehouse World — Sleep in a Treehouse + Full Scenic Ticket Pack, from ¥699 (≈$98)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a treehouse + breakfasts + full scenic ticket pack — from ¥699 (≈$98) (was ¥2,599, about 27% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

“Go to the mountains — nature has the answers” is this place’s motto, and it delivers: 21 themed treehouses and villas — Lego-block, North American, steam-train, lighthouse, watchtower, flying-saucer and even a 123㎡ “airplane” masterwork — scattered through the pine forests of Qiyun Mountain, one of China’s four great Taoist mountains. Each sits apart with its own patch of mountain and cloud, many with viewing decks where you can watch the morning mist from bed. Around 3 hours by car from Shanghai, 2 hours from Hangzhou, with a shuttle from Huangshan North station.

item.title: Shangrao Yuexi Kaiyuan Guantang — Huizhou-Style Garden Resort by Lingshan Mountain, from ¥428 (≈$60)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast + hanfu experience — from ¥428 (≈$60) (was ¥1,386, about 31% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A light-luxury cultural resort run by the Delong hotel group in the foothills of Lingshan Mountain — “the 33rd blessed land” — about 20 minutes from Shangrao railway station and 12 km from Lingshan scenic area. More than twenty restored Huizhou heritage houses, a traditional tea-oil workshop and classical Chinese gardens are woven into 40,900㎡ of landscaped grounds, so the whole stay feels like stepping into a quiet Jiangnan painting. Shangrao itself sits where Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian and Anhui meet, an easy high-speed-rail hop from Shanghai, Hangzhou, Xiamen or Fuzhou — and a handy base for Lingshan, Wangxian Valley and Gexian Village.

item.title: Liyang Tianmu Lake Hantian Mengshe Resort — Pet-Friendly Lakeside Escape, 2 Nights from ¥788 (≈$111)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfasts + afternoon tea + park tickets — from ¥699 (≈$98) (was ¥999, about 70% of list) · Pet-friendly & family 2-night tiers · Weekends with no surcharge · ⏰ valid through Mar 31, 2027

Tianmu Lake is one of the Yangtze Delta’s classic escapes — clear water, scattered islets, a winding shoreline — and Hantian Resort sits right on its peninsula, a private-lake-island-style property of 4,000+ mu backed by hills and wrapped in bamboo. The name says it all: “han” for water, nourishment and openness; “tian” for the fertile land that holds everything. Stand on the hillside terrace, breathe the bamboo air, and watch the lake wind away between layered mountains.

item.title: Nanjing Qixia Mountain Hantian Qiyunshanfang Hotel — Zen Stay + Maple Mountain Tickets, ¥488 (≈$69)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfasts + vegetarian noodles + 2 Qixia Mountain tickets + Zen experience — from ¥488 (≈$69) (was ¥999, about 49% of list) · Autumn maple season + valid to Jun 2027 · ⏰ valid through Jun 30, 2027

“One Qixia Mountain, half the history of Jinling” — and this hotel sits right at its foot, next to the famous Qixia Temple, one of China’s four great temples. Hantian Qiyunshanfang is Chinese Zen through and through: the same flying-eaves rooflines as the temple, symmetrical courtyards, white space and water features, and a whole Heart Sutra wall greeting you at check-in. Every corner is photogenic, and the stillness is the point — a place to let a city-frazzled mind settle.

item.title: Qingdao Sports Town Fun World — Unlimited Rides All Day, ¥49 (≈$7)
item.description:
Deal price: unlimited same-day rides — from ¥49 (≈$7) (was ¥199, about 25% of list) · No ticket exchange needed, buy and go · ⏰ valid through Dec 13, 2026

One of the best-value family days out in Qingdao right now. Sports Town Fun World sits inside the 200-mu Citizen Fitness Center on the city’s north coast (Metro Line 8, Citizen Fitness Center station; near the international expo center and the outlet mall), and a single ticket unlocks 10 attractions unlimited all day: space walk, peace mission, rainbow slide, lakeside train, bumper cars, dream carousel, bay racing, dynamic flying chairs, high-altitude rafting and a water yacht — plus 3 themed parks (dinosaur park, cute-pet park and a non-powered play park) and the brand-new QIQI indoor trampoline zone. Lifelike dinosaurs — T. rex, the meat-eating giant Niu Long — walk you straight into a Jurassic jungle, and the bouncy-cloud zone suits kids of all ages. You can even bring your own tent and camp on the lawn for an outdoor day.

item.title: Xiamen Shengzhixiang Hot Spring Resort — 1 Night + Unlimited Hot Springs for 2 Adults & 2 Kids, ¥568 (≈$80)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfasts + unlimited hot springs for 2 adults & 2 kids — from ¥568 (≈$80) (was ¥1,118, about 51% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A 210,000㎡ wellness resort tucked into Tong’an’s Tingxi valley — forest, hot springs, herbs and good food, far from the city noise. Shengzhixiang sits on natural sodium-bicarbonate springs from deep under Tingxi, nicknamed “beauty soup” water, and its signature is the cave hot spring: warm in winter, cool in summer, constant temperature all year. The outdoor spring park runs original-soup pools with free tea service, pools of every size hidden among flowers by an infinity pool, and water that flows and refreshes continuously, cleaned and disinfected daily. Between soaks, stroll the hillside boardwalk, and kids get a water park and an indoor playground on site.

item.title: Xiamen Xianglu International Hotel Buffet — Chaoshan Beef Hotpot Feast, ¥108 (≈$15)
item.description:
Deal price: single buffet, lunch or dinner interchangeable — from ¥108 (≈$15) (was ¥198, about 55% of list) · Weekends & holidays included · ⏰ valid through Mar 10, 2027

Xianglu International Hotel’s Four Seasons restaurant has switched its buffet to a Chaoshan beef hotpot theme for autumn and winter — and at ¥108 it’s one of the best-value hotel buffets in Xiamen right now. The star is fresh-cut beef, sliced to order and never held overnight: dip it for seconds in a clear southern-ginger beef-bone broth or a satay-spiced pot, with the classic Chaoshan dips (satay sauce, Puning bean paste, celery bits) ready to go. Alongside the beef: sliced chicken, pork and lamb rolls, mushrooms, tofu and vegetable sides, meatballs and fish balls, and a rotating cast of small eats.

item.title: Hangzhou Ludi Ancient Hot Spring Huanglong Resort from ¥599 (≈$83) — Unlimited Springs + Late 14:00 Checkout
item.description:
Deal price: ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥2006 — 70% off) for 1 night · ⏰ Valid October 24, 2026 – February 28, 2027 · Fridays and Saturdays at no surcharge · Refundable if unbooked

A thousand-year-old spring in Hangzhou’s western mountains: the ¥599 tier buys a Yunqi king or twin room (35–40㎡) for 1 night with breakfast for 2, unlimited access to the Ludi ancient hot springs for 2, welcome fruit, a nightly sweet soup, drink and dining vouchers, 24-hour gym and laundry, and free parking. The deal’s quiet superpower is the clock: check-in from 12:00 and checkout at 14:00 — a full extra morning in the springs versus the usual noon checkout — and Fridays and Saturdays carry no surcharge, so a winter weekend soak costs the same as a weekday one. The ¥999 2-night tier repeats the inclusions across both nights (or splits into 2 rooms for 1 night), and a ¥1299 2-night tier adds afternoon tea and a set meal for 2.

item.title: Hangzhou Xianghu Baoyi Kaiyuan Metropark Double-11 Deal from ¥499 (≈$69) — Lake Cruise + Hotpot + Senbo Park Option
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥2188 — 77% off) for 1 night · ⏰ Valid September 25, 2026 – March 31, 2027 · New Year dates at no surcharge (limited) · Refundable if unbooked

A Double-11 lake-district stay on Hangzhou’s Xianghu: the ¥499 tier buys a superior king or twin room (35–38㎡) for 1 night with breakfast for 2, a 3-in-1 attraction pick (2 Shanli Renjia park tickets, 2 Xianghu cruise tickets, or 2 Luxigu valley tickets), a ¥50 dining voucher (off a ¥200 spend) and welcome fruit, plus free Wi-Fi, a heated indoor pool, gym and indoor parking. The ¥898 2-night tier upgrades to a 47㎡ terrace room and adds a hotpot dinner (mutton stew or local chicken pot, worth ¥128–188) and 2 Xianghu cruise tickets. A ¥599 tier swaps the cruise for a Senbo water-park or Fantasy Island family ticket (1 adult + 1 child) plus a set meal for 2 — handy if you’re pairing the lake with a kids’ park day.

item.title: Jiaxing Kaiyuan Senbo Resort Double-11 Deal from ¥666 (≈$93) — Water Park + Fantasy Island + Craft Workshop
item.description:
Deal price: ¥666 (≈$93, was ¥1298 — 49% off) for 1 night · ⏰ Valid October 23, 2026 – June 30, 2027 · No surcharge before March 31, 2027 (except winter break and holidays) · Refundable if unbooked

A Double-11-priced return to the Senbo resort beside Jiaxing’s Nanbei Lake: the ¥666 tier buys a Senbo king or twin room for 1 night with breakfast for 2 at the cave restaurant, 2 tickets to either the water park or Fantasy Island, a craft-workshop pick (1 of 3), a family photo shoot (3 retouched photos + a 15-second video), welcome fruit plus first-day minibar drinks, and the nightly 19:00 and 20:00 lakeside music-and-water show. The resort pairs a 31,000㎡ indoor-and-outdoor water park (indoor section open year-round) with a 2,300㎡ indoor kids’ park, Fantasy Island — enough for two full days without leaving the grounds, and the shuttle-served grounds sit right by the 4A Nanbei Lake scenic area, about an hour’s drive from Shanghai or Hangzhou.

item.title: Xiamen Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort Double-11 Deal from ¥688 (≈$96) — Private-Pool Wooden Cabin + Hot Springs
item.description:
Deal price: ¥688 (≈$96, was ¥1298 — 47% off) for 1 night · ⏰ Valid October 24 – December 30, 2026 · Refundable if unbooked, auto-refund on expiry

A Double-11 hot-spring escape in Xiamen’s Haicang hills: the ¥688 tier buys a premium hot-spring room for 1 night with breakfast for 2 adults and 2 kids, hot-spring park tickets for 2 adults and 2 kids, 2 kids’ fun-palace tickets and 2 Haven Club entries, plus pet interactions (an Alaskan dog in the morning, squirrels all day), an open-air evening movie, a morning baduanjin session, stargazing meditation, and a free shuttle to Dongfu metro station. For a slower soak, the ¥799 tier swaps the room for a garden wooden cabin with its own private soaking pool — 1 room for 2 nights or 2 rooms for 1 night — with 2 adult hot-spring tickets per room-night (each adult may bring 1 child under 1.2 m free), plus a forest sound-and-singing-bowl therapy session.

item.title: Yangzhou Yizheng Garden Expo Junlan Resort from ¥599 (≈$83) — Garden-View Suite, Weekends & New Year No Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥899 — 33% off) for 1 night · ⏰ Valid October 21, 2026 – January 31, 2027 · Weekends and New Year at no surcharge · Refundable if unbooked

A quiet garden-expo-side suite stay between Yangzhou and Nanjing: the ¥599 tier buys a luxury garden-view suite for 1 night with breakfast for 2, welcome fruit, a signature drink and free parking. The suite tier is the value story here — a full suite, not a standard room, at a standard-room price — and the weekend and New Year dates carry no surcharge, so a Friday-to-Sunday escape costs the same as a Tuesday night. Two-night options stretch the same inclusions across both nights.
